 The teams are IN ahead of Matchweek 5 of the 2026/27 A-League Men campaign.
 Catch up with all the team news below.
 CLICK HERE TO GET YOUR TICKETS TO THE 2026/27 A-LEAGUE MEN SEASON 
 The Big Talking Points 
 Perth Glory skipper Tom Lawrence missed Glory’s away trip to Mariners.
 Adelaide United welcome back talented youngster Jacob Brazete. 
 Melbourne Victory forward Guillermo May returns from injury for Auckland trip.
 Western Sydney Wanderers defender Anthony Pantazopoulos remains sidelined due to hamstring injury.
 Central Coast Mariners name midfielder Harry Steele for visit of Perth.
